title: Noor and the Room
author: S. M. Brightwater
blurb: Vesper Halloran, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
